model: BREITLING Navitimer B01 Chronograph 41 AB0139211B1P1 (41 mm steel, black dial, silver sub-dials, black leather strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). NAVITIMER: structure of the Breitling Superocean 42 build (watch_breitling_superocean42) plus chronograph parts measured from the photo: 56-tooth coin-edge steel bezel with the engraved slide-rule scales as print, crown without guards, two plain-cylinder pushers at 2 and 4 o'clock (radial at +-30 deg), sub-dial needles and ball hubs, red chronograph seconds hand with grey tail, bar-lume hour and minute hands, one-piece black leather strap. Later Navitimer / chronograph variants copy this spec and change what differs.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 220 / bottoms y 721 px, tooth tips of the coin edge on the sides); top and bottom slope toward the strap

bezel.note: steel bezel: flat engraved slide-rule ring (bezel_in..insert_out, scales are print in the photo) and a 56-tooth coin ring (insert_out..bezel_out, tooth profile in px about the ring centre, 20 steps per period from the tip centre at phase_deg clockwise from 12)

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, thr 45..110 silhouettes in rotated strips (see the measure file), 0.03 mm wider than the photographed hands so the 3D hands hide them; the last point sits at the traced length. The hour and minute lume bars and the chamfers are in the projected photo (hands_photo). offset_mm shifts the whole seconds hand (red hand 1.07 px left of the pivot). Sub-dial needles are hands.polygons (mm about the pivot), ball hubs hands.discs.

crown.note: crown without guards: box x 731..765.5 px, y 433..509 px (radius 3.49 mm), 16 flutes to x 758 px, then a rounded cap

strap.note: strap.kind leather: ONE flat section (black leather with white stitching, texture = the projected photo) from its photographed ends at the bezel (top y 264, bottom y 688 px; pieces_mm) to the alpha ends (top y 103, bottom y 920 px); outline = the silhouette rows beyond edge_from (strap-wide above the lug tops); the strap narrows toward the rounded ends.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

pushers.note: two chronograph pushers radial from (513.07, 470.6) px at +-30 deg (end-face centres at 256.55 px = 23.59 mm, cap diameter 4.0 mm, cap 2.3 mm long, collar tube r 0.55 mm); steel_photo texture
